gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a 1,024 Wh / 1,800 W kit with a 200 W panel (the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 200 W, one of our listed products) costs $531 on the maker's US store today. That is $198 less than the $729 EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 220 W card ChatGPT made its top pick, and EcoFlow's own store sells its DELTA 3 Classic Solar Generator for $669, $60 below that card.
standout_why: Cited rival pages compared: flowersofvice.com lists three 1 kWh kits, all priced at writing: Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 about $749, EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus + 220 W about $899 and BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W about $679. It names no ALLPOWERS kit, and no kit at that capacity under about $679. Its AC180 + 200 W price is also below BLUETTI's $769 today. powerstationgearlab.com prices bare power stations only (EcoFlow Delta 2, Jackery 1000 v2, Anker C1000, BLUETTI AC180, EcoFlow River 3 Plus) and names no panel or kit. I could not open urbangridbackup.com, the cited #1 result, because of a certificate error, so I can't rule out that it covers this. I did not read the uncited results (wattfolk, solutionenergy, powerbencher). ChatGPT's own cards were $729 for the DELTA 3 Classic + 220 W (Best Buy), $399.99 for the Anker C300 + 60 W and $699 or $789 for the Jackery 1000 V2 + 200 W.
decides: On price, this flips the 1 kWh value pick. For the same 1,024 Wh and 1,800 W AC output, the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 200 W ($531) beats ChatGPT's DELTA 3 Classic + 220 W ($729 at Best Buy, $669 from EcoFlow) and the BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W ($769, which has 128 Wh more). For a small balcony, the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W at $489.99 now costs only $42 less than the 1 kWh P1800 kit. That weakens it as a budget pick unless weight or size decides. Two things need checking before the ALLPOWERS kit can lead the page. First, the store did not name the included panel (I could not open the product page). Second, I have no sourced panel size or weight to show it fits a balcony.
